name: cvar-unhide-s2-citadel
notes: Unmodified official release DLL. The upstream full gameinfo.gi is intentionally not bundled or installed. Dolly backs up the current local gameinfo bytes and temporarily mounts the DLL via its SearchPaths; it restores after plugin initialization or game exit, with journaled crash recovery. The standard citadel game identity is retained. Release binary compatibility with current Deadlock must be verified on Windows.
